objective: Use externally documented physical-control events (ball weighing, ball-set replacement, machine change, incident, maintenance) to define mechanical eras, then test whether any number/position bias survives temporal holdout and matched-null simulation without outcome-defined cut points.

facts: IGAE officials attend preparatory/executive draw acts and ball-weighing acts.
SELAE and IGAE establish a semiannual calendar of periodic ball weighings.
Ball weighings are performed early in the morning on dates agreed by the monitoring commission.
Officials sign the corresponding documents for the acts they attend.
IGAE attendance is intended to ensure compliance and transparency.

candidateExternalBoundaries: documented machine replacement or maintenance date
testsPlanned: main-set marginal frequency stability by era
serial dependence and adjacency structure by era
Monte Carlo matched-null with identical draw counts and calendar segmentation

requires: effect size large enough to change ticket probability materially
independent replication across another era or game
